purpose: Asset + layout manifest. Read this together with the Lobby mockup to rebuild the page exactly. All assets are lossy WebP with alpha, kept at the mockup's native resolution (about 2.18x the design size) so they stay sharp on retina screens and light.

stage.horizontal: stage fills the viewport width exactly (no side padding); centered if the viewport is wider than 390*1.3
stage.units: All numbers below are DESIGN px (390-wide stage). Multiply by scale for screen px.

ready_button.note: Same size and radius as the Create game button on Game settings

vertical_layout_design_px.note: Design y positions at stage height 844. Gaps shrink/grow with the screen height (see gaps).

blocks.note: only the inner paddings shrink to reach min_height; avatars, pills and ring never scale

blocks.what: links -> stage bottom (absorbs all extra height)

vertical_layout_design_px.solver: If H >= 844: grow gaps T..G up to max in proportion to (max-design), put every remaining pixel in H. If 639 <= H < 844: shrink every gap and the card inner padding in proportion to (design-min). If H < 639: compact mode, scale the whole content cluster (BACK..LINKS) uniformly by k = max(0.85, H/639) from the top center; below that allow vertical scroll.

rules: Never draw avatars, blobs, starbursts, stars, hearts, crescents, crosses, sparkles or the emoji with CSS/SVG. Use these files.
Layer order: decorations (z0) < card and content (z1-z3) < nothing covers the buttons.
Decorations are pointer-events:none and never cover text or controls.
Use safe-area insets: add env(safe-area-inset-top)/scale to T and env(safe-area-inset-bottom)/scale to H.
Never use 100vh. Measure the real visible height (visualViewport) and use it for the stage height.
